author: Young Jae Lee
axis: drug<->DISEASE indication (NOT the drug<->target direction axis of V1-V7)

binding_table.fold_rule: lowercase; non-alphanumeric->space; ae->e, oe->e; per-token singularize; order-insensitive token-set identity, applied identically to slug and MeSH name
binding_table.inheritance: EXACT (18) and CURATED_SPECIFIC (13) inherited VERBATIM from V8 (0 changed); GROUP_SINGLE_REFERENT extends V8's 4 by ONE warranted grown-core binding (CAH); REJECTED extends V8's 6 by THREE grown-core tempting-but-wrong bindings
binding_table.new_binding_warrant: 0 new EXACT (fold-identity) matches exist over the extended may_treat MeSH universe; the single new GROUP binding (congenital_adrenal_hyperplasia_21ohd -> D000312) mirrors the V8 AIP -> D017094 precedent
binding_table.principle: bind slug<->MeSH classId iff the MeSH term has a SINGLE canonical in-model referent AND is not a pure symptom / broad multi-etiology umbrella; token-overlap auto-binding rejected

catecholaminergic_polymorphic_ventricula: GT carries only ventricular/supraventricular arrhythmia symptom umbrellas, none CPVT-specific
hartnup_disorder: nicotinamide -> 'Pellagra' is the nutritional niacin-deficiency phenotype, NOT the genetic SLC6A19 transporter defect (different etiology) -- mirrors the riboflavin_transporter REJECT
molybdenum_cofactor_deficiency_a: fosdenopterin -> 'Metal Metabolism, Inborn Errors' is a BROAD group (Wilson/Menkes/haemochromatosis also in-model) -- not a 1:1 MoCD-A referent
n_acetylglutamate_synthase_deficiency: carglumic acid -> 'Hyperammonemia' is a SYMPTOM umbrella with many in-model referents (NAGS/OTC/citrullinemia/argininosuccinic aciduria) -- not a 1:1 NAGS referent
neonatal_severe_hyperparathyroidism: adult Primary Hyperparathyroidism / Hypercalcemia symptom -- different disease
riboflavin_transporter_deficiency: nutritional Riboflavin Deficiency != the genetic SLC52 transporter defect (different etiology)
transthyretin_amyloidosis: D000686 Amyloidosis spans AL/AA/ATTR; D028227 is the familial-neuropathy subtype only -- neither is a 1:1 referent

binding_table.reporting: all primary metrics reported at BOTH Tiers1-2 and Tiers1-3 so the group stratum is never hidden; plus a string-variant-collapsed recall sensitivity

determinism: metrics computed from the VENDORED snapshot (byte-frozen manifest); a fresh live re-pull is an off-manifest sidecar. Two runs are byte-identical.
expected_negative: MED-RT may_treat coverage is thin for ultra-rare monogenic disease and new modalities (gene/cell therapies, diets, vitamins, combination products often carry zero edges; some indications coded only to a generic parent). Denominators are SMALL and many grown-core rediscoveries are unconfirmed for lack of an edge -- reported as a coverage cost of an independent oracle, not a kit-label failure.

additive_lineage.policy: 105 V8 agent edges copied byte-identical; only new grown-core agents fetched

ground_truth.api: NLM RxClass class/byDrugName (relaSource=MEDRT, rela=may_treat), filtered classType==DISEASE
ground_truth.independence: indication relation, NOT mechanism; V5 used the same API for has_moa only
ground_truth.magnitude_free: categorical (drug, MeSH-disease) edges only; no dose/percent/efficacy/p-value/n-of-m
ground_truth.source: MED-RT (NLM/VA Medication Reference Terminology) may_treat indication edges

inheritance_discipline.chain: APPEND-ONLY, continuing the V16 validation chain head
inheritance_discipline.derivation: READ-ONLY over the GROWN 152-core (0 re-runs); inherited anchors re-checked byte-identical
inheritance_discipline.invariants: firewall PASS; every emitted string magnitude-free
inheritance_discipline.source: vendored dated snapshot (snapshot_sha256 above); live re-pull is an off-manifest audit

metrics.cross_tab: GT-confirmation by kit label (rediscovery|novel); novel-but-confirmed = conservative
metrics.negative_control: inherited V8 instrument: gene-specific agents must carry tight non-leaking sets
metrics.precision: of scoped rediscovery pairs (slug bound AND agent resolved in RxNav), fraction MED-RT confirms via a may_treat edge to the bound MeSH disease; unconfirmed listed with reason
metrics.recall: of in-scope GT indications (agent in corpus, disease bound & in-model), fraction the kit surfaced as a specific (slug, agent) pair; misses annotated alternative-agent vs honest-gap

re_pin_of: V8 (128-core); identical protocol, grown substrate; V8 left byte-identical.

rediscovery_label_source.classification: rediscovery = agent has an approved/established indication SPECIFICALLY for that disease at snapshot date; novel = no such indication (direction-only [O] hypothesis)

section: 00_CONTINUATION_BLUEPRINT.md 11.4(b) -- rediscovery precision/recall vs an independent indication ground truth, GROWN 152-core re-pin of V8.
what_v17_does_NOT_do: does not add/re-derive any disease (0 re-derivation; core is e7c byte-identical)
does not re-admit any lever family or re-label any row
does not claim any drug is efficacious (an indication edge is categorical, not an efficacy)
does not claim any magnitude (dose/efficacy/response/survival/p-value/n-of-m) -- firewall PASS
does not mutate the frozen V8 128-core audit or its snapshot
